description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git fetch/push functionality over HTTP, including setup of server and client repositories, push operations with different negotiation strategies, and validation of object counts.

methods.name: grep_wrote
methods.description: Function to check the number of objects written during a push by parsing the trace output.
